description: Fetch an audit's status and, when complete, a compact decision-ready SUMMARY: AEO score (overall + FIND/READ/USE), a short summary, the weakest pillar, headline takeaways, and the top fixes. Lead with this; call get_audit_detail only when you need the full per-section breakdown.

audit_id.description: The audit_id returned by run_audit / compare_aeo (poll until status is completed).

name: get_audit

outputSchema.description: When still running, only audit_id + status are returned (plus a poll pointer). When complete, the full lean summary below is returned.

provisional_note.description: On a partial audit, a short note explaining the scores are provisional and how to get a fresh run; null otherwise.

scores_provisional.description: True when the audit finished with status 'partial' (some audit steps failed), so scores are provisional. Reflects the stored status only — false is not a reliability guarantee.

suggested_next_calls.description: Advisory next-tool-call pointers (suggested_next_calls). Score-neutral agent UX.

reason.description: Why this is the natural next step.

summary.description: Short natural-language summary (capped at a word boundary).

summary_truncated.description: True when the summary was clipped to the cap (ends with an ellipsis).

weakest_pillar.description: FIND | READ | USE | null (no clear weakest).

title: Get Audit Summary
